title: The Tale of Despereaux
author: Kate DiCamillo
summary: A tiny mouse with oversized ears loves music, stories and a human princess. His devotion draws him into the dungeons, where a rat and a lonely serving girl have their own grievances.
readIf: you enjoy fairy-tale narrators who speak straight to the reader about courage and forgiveness.
skipIf: you prefer fast, modern fantasy with lots of action and little commentary.
